item.title: Fullback Robbie Ouzts only player questionable to play for Seattle Seahawks in Super Bowl
item.description: Fullback Robbie Ouzts is the only player uncertain to play for the Seattle Seahawks because of an injury for Super Bowl LX against the New England Patriots on Sunday.

item.title: Two Everett, WA buildings evacuated over 'suspicious substance' in ballot box
item.description: Two administrative buildings on the Snohomish County campus in Everett were evacuated after a "suspicious substance" was found in a ballot box.

item.title: School district in Seattle responds to student walkouts over ICE policies
item.description: More student walkouts are hitting Seattle Public Schools in response to federal ICE policies. The school district has issued a response to the wider community about their safety limits.

item.title: Another CHOP shooting victim files lawsuit against City of Seattle
item.description: The other teen who was shot alongside Antonio Mays Jr. inside the Capitol Hill Occupied Protest (CHOP) in 2020 has filed a lawsuit against Seattle.

item.title: 'Seattle News Weekly': Youth violence, layoffs, Super Bowl LX
item.description: On this episode of the "Seattle News Weekly" podcast, FOX 13 Seattle Anchors Erin Mayovsky and Adam Gherke discuss youth violence and tech layoffs in Seattle and the Seahawks in Super Bowl 2026.

item.title: What would it take for Seattle to host the Super Bowl?
item.description: With the Seahawks defying the odds to clinch the biggest game in football of the year, some are wondering, could Seattle ever host the Super Bowl?

item.title: 'Fanbulance Unit 12' brings doses of Seahawks pride to North Sound
item.description: With nearly 400,000 miles on the odometer, a reimagined ambulance is making rounds all over Whidbey Island and the North Sound, serving as a Seahawks fan's first response unit.

item.title: 14 people indicted in Tacoma street gang drug trafficking ring
item.description: Federal agents dismantled a major drug trafficking ring tied to a Tacoma street gang, arresting and indicting 14 people across three states.

item.title: How to watch Super Bowl 2026 throughout Washington
item.description: There's plenty of places to celebrate the Seattle Seahawks in Super Bowl LX on Sunday, all across western Washington.

item.title: Seahawks rookie safety Nick Emmanwori fully participates in practice ahead of Super Bowl
item.description: Seattle Seahawks rookie safety Nick Emmanwori, who injured his ankle on Wednesday, was a full participant in practice on Friday ahead of Super Bowl 60.
